tldr: Lilith in the 10th house: the untamed in public life
body: Lilith in the 10th house: the untamed in public life. Where you reclaim power and visibility outside the rules. Watch: a reputation built on defiance, or being cast as the villain. You refuse to be controlled in public life; raw ambition that will not play the expected role. Needs unconventional, self-directed work and resists rigid authority; may go marginal or self-employed. Originality is an asset in creative fields, a liability in rigid ones.
business: Authority claimed on your own terms, often as an outsider.
shadow: Self-sabotage of reputation, or a combative public face.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Imported from approved project Black Moon Lilith house material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
